messages:
kelly: Quick follow-up to the hosting abstraction RFC. Proposal: add a tiny, deterministic discovery probe so Private can optionally run without a sidecar. Keep the probe tiny, cache the result per-tenant, and include a graceful translation proxy for legacy installs.

art: High-level question: how do we avoid adding measurable latency to request paths?

kelly: We only block on the very first request for a tenant when the cache is cold. Probe is synchronous only on first contact, then cached. Target <12ms p95 on warm connections.

samir: Security guardrails: controlplane must not accept raw key material. Runtime should provide an attestation blob and mTLS cert identity; controlplane validates signatures and uses references for KMS policies.

kelly: Exactly. Auth hint in the manifest will list the auth pattern (e.g., "attest+mTLS"). No key transport.

art: If the runtime doesn't implement the probe endpoint, what's the fallback?

kelly: Fallback is a lightweight translation proxy we run in-hosted that implements the legacy sidecar protocol on behalf of the runtime. We mark the tenant as "translation_proxy" and emit a metric translation_proxy_routes. Also surface a prominent console banner recommending runtime upgrade.

samir: Add an immutable audit event when we create a translation mapping (tenant, reason, deploy id). Security needs that for forensics and retention.

ops-bot: action: create feature-flag "sidecarless_optin", metrics discovery_latency_ms, discovery_error_pct, translation_proxy_rate, and alert if translation_proxy_rate > 2% over 10m.

kelly: Minimal manifest we propose for runtime implementers (very compact):

```
POST /_discover
Request: {"probe_v":"1","cp_id":"us-east-phi"}
Response 200: {"tenant":"acme","caps":["kvcache","batch_v2"],"auth_hint":"attest+mTLS","variants":["q4","q8"],"cap_ttl":300}
```

samir: Make cap_ttl advisory. We'll enforce bounds (min 30s, max 3600s) and allow runtime to send shorter TTLs for rapid-change environments. Also require a webhook so runtime can push a manifest-change event to invalidate cache on key rotation.

art: What about routing preferences between Dedicated and Private where we might prefer different quantized variants?

kelly: Manifest includes a small "variants" list (preferred order). Router will pick the first compatible variant available in the target hosting mode. We won't expose max_seq_len as a routing constraint; keep it advisory.

samir: Testing: unit parsing and cache eviction, an emulated runtime for integration tests, and a staged canary in Dedicated before enabling for Private.

kelly: Rollout plan: 1) enable feature-flag sidecarless_optin for internal tenants, 2) Dedicated 48h canary, 3) opt-in Private tenants, 4) broad enable when discovery_error_pct < 0.5% and translation_proxy_rate < 1% over 1h.

art: Circuit-breaker: if discovery_error_pct > 3% over 5m we auto-switch new tenants to translation_proxy for the SLO window, page on-call, and annotate tenant state in the cache.

samir: Add fine-grained metrics: discovery_latency_ms histogram, discovery_parse_errors, attest_validation_failures. Log runtime_cert_subject and attest_expiry in audit events (but never the private keys).

ops-bot: add dashboard tile: translation_proxy_cost_estimate per-tenant for billing visibility.

kelly: Good catch. We'll tag translation_proxy routes so finance/sales can see if a customer is incurring extra infra cost.

art: One more operational concern: some installs may flip between modes rapidly during deployment. We should debounce manifest changes server-side to avoid flapping.

kelly: Agreed. We'll apply a short debounce window (default 10s) for manifest-change webhooks and allow tenants to request immediate invalidation in emergencies via an authenticated endpoint.

samir: I'll draft the minimal runtime README and example probe server (Go + curl example). Also will put sample validation pseudocode for attest checks.

kelly: I'll own the follow-up RFC: state machine, probe schema, cache policy, circuit-breaker rules, and rollout checklist. Can we keep the feature-flag name different from earlier threads to avoid confusion? I prefer "sidecarless_optin" here.

art: Fine by me. I'll take the integration tests and pair with Samir.

ops-bot: reminder: include the translation_proxy_rate metric in the billing exports and add an alert when discovery_error_pct increases by >1% relative to baseline."
